# Batch & Build

> Batch & Build is a small home and planning shop. It sells made-to-order home goods (rugs, candles, clocks, pillows, blankets, wall art and kitchen pieces) and instant-download printable planners, trackers, spreadsheet templates and guides. Tagline: "Make home life easier."

- Website: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/
- Shop (home goods): https://batchandbuildco.co.site/home-goods/
- Digital downloads by category: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/shop.html
- Blog: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/
- Contact: info@batchandbuildco.co.site

## Shipping & returns
- Home goods are made to order, ships in about 5–9 business days (US only).
- Damaged or defective items: email info@batchandbuildco.co.site within 30 days with a photo for a replacement or refund. Made-to-order items can't be returned for change of mind.
- Digital downloads are delivered instantly after checkout. Refund policy: https://batchandbuildco.co.site/refunds.html

## Blog
- [30-Day Meal Prep Grocery List](https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/30-day-meal-prep-grocery-list.html): A practical, flexible grocery list framework for a month of high-protein meal prep, plus tips for shopping on a budget and storing food safely.
- [How to Budget Biweekly Paychecks](https://batchandbuildco.co.site/blog/how-to-budget-biweekly-paychecks.html): A simple, paycheck-by-paycheck method for budgeting when you're paid every two weeks, including what to do in the months with three paychecks.
